name: RAISE-26
description: National AI-Informatics competition! Teams of 2–5 analyze how AI is transforming human behavior using data science, NLP, and machine learning. Open to undergrad and grad students across disciplines. Compete for up to $5,000 and present at Rutgers University.

name: AI-HDL Competition
description: Compete in the AI-HDL Competition, where teams leverage AI to generate and optimize hardware description language (HDL) designs. CSAI is the only community college in the world participating in this prestigious competition, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven hardware design.
